visual_identity.core_identity: An empty suit of medieval plate armor moving under magical force, with no visible wearer inside.
visual_identity.silhouette: Full humanoid armor silhouette in a deliberate stepping pose, rigid plates separated by empty gaps.
visual_identity.head_features: Closed or partly open helmet with empty darkness where a face would be; no eyes or flesh.
visual_identity.body_shape: Articulated breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, greaves, and boots moving as a complete hollow suit.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Armor articulates only through its existing humanoid joints; no biological body or robot mechanisms are added.
visual_identity.surface: Broad simple metal plates with a few dents and edge lines, avoiding ornate engraving.

scene_identity.natural_posture: Standing or stepping through its own articulated joints with feet visibly planted.

accuracy_checks: pieces stay connected as one suit

known_failure_modes.symptom: human or skeleton appears inside armor
known_failure_modes.correction: restore visibly empty helmet and plate gaps
remove machinery and keep ordinary medieval plate animated by magic
